dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 07, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Brewers Edge Cardinals in Thrilling Doubleheader, Wheeler Dominates Phillies**

In a pair of thrilling matchups, the Milwaukee Brewers took down the St. Louis Cardinals in a doubleheader, winning 4-3 and 10-2. Christian Yelich delivered a crucial double in the first game, while Jordan Walker's two-run homer was the top hitting performance. On the mound, Jacob Misiorowski shined with 7.0 innings of one-hit ball, striking out 11. The Brewers' pitching staff also excelled in the second game, with Robert Gasser tossing 7.2 scoreless innings.

Zack Wheeler was nearly unhittable for the Philadelphia Phillies, fanning 14 in 7.0 innings of one-run ball against the Cincinnati Reds. Kyle Schwarber hit a two-run homer for the Phillies. Meanwhile, in the American League, the Chicago Cubs' Matthew Boyd threw 6.0 shutout innings against the Baltimore Orioles, striking out 7. Alex Bregman drove in two runs for the Cubs.
